thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert: INC-20284 latency-slo-burn (p99 > 1.2s) - region=eu-west - auto-page fired
pagerduty: PagerDuty: Page triggered to #eng-oncall (INC-20284) — escalation policy: latency-critical
Alex G: acked on PD, taking ownership (I'll be primary until handoff). grabbing dashboards now.
Priya S: joining. seen any recent deploys?
Samir K: nope, no deploys in last 40m. quick glance: p95 up to 600ms, p99 spike to 1.6s. request rate stable.
Maria L: CS pinged, two small enterprise customers reported slow responses for the last ~6m. could be request fanout.
Alex G: looking at inference-runtime traces -> hot path latency concentrated on tokenization + kv-cache misses. high eviction rate reported.
Priya S: kv-cache metrics: eviction-rate spiked x10, memory pressure on sidecars in eu-west. hotkeys present.
Samir K: sidecars CPU also showing jitter, GC-ish pauses around same timestamps. correlates with increased batch sizes.
Alex G: running quick mitigation: disable async-aggregate-batching for eu-west to avoid overly large batches increasing tail.
Alex G: command: 
```
# flip flag to disable async batching for region
redwoodctl feature-flags set async-aggregate-batching false --region eu-west --env prod
```
Priya S: doing it now — pushing change to control plane.
incident-bot: FeatureFlagChange: async-aggregate-batching=false applied to eu-west (change id ff-9842).
Samir K: while that's rolling, suggest routing new requests to fallback model variant (quantized smaller) to reduce per-request compute. low-risk fallback available.
Alex G: agree. doing model fallback for low-priority customers first.
Alex G: command: 
```
redwoodctl routes set-fallback --route /generate --region eu-west --model rwd-v1-small-quantized
```
pagerduty: Escalation: SRE lead (Priya S) notified (15s ago).
Priya S: increasing sidecar replica count temporarily to relieve memory pressure — autoscaler bumped min replicas + manual scale.
Priya S: command: 
```
kubectl scale deploy/sidecar-eu-west --replicas=12 -n redwood-runtime
```
Maria L: notifying affected customers with templated message: "We're investigating elevated latency in EU. Temporary routing and config changes in progress."
Samir K: KV-cache warmup in progress after fallback routing. eviction rate trending down. p99 sampling: 1.6 -> 1.25 after batching flag flip (10s).
Alex G: still seeing a small tail around tokenization stage for long prompts. possible tokenizer coldstart on some hosts.
Priya S: rolling small restart to tokenizer workers in eu-west pool to clear any stuck processes (staggered).
Alex G: executing rolling restart job: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/tokenizer-eu-west` (stagger 30s between pods).
incident-bot: Restart job started (job id rj-7721). progress: 3/12 pods restarted.
Samir K: dashboards show p99 trending down to ~0.95s. p95 at ~420ms. request error rate stable.
Alex G: raising PD incident status to "mitigating" — assigning followups.
pagerduty: INC-20284 status changed to mitigating by Alex G.
Maria L: CS updated customers. no escalations to legal/enterprise sales required at this point.
Priya S: mitigation notes: 1) disabled async batching 2) increased replicas 3) set fallback model 4) restarted tokenizer workers. All changes tagged in ops tracker INC-20284.
Samir K: will monitor for next 20m. if p99 < 1.0s and stable -> close.
Alex G: agreed. keeping PD ack until stable. if anyone needs to take over, ping me with `@Alex G take` — otherwise I'll hand off to Oncall Rotation at 18:20 UTC.
Oncall Rotation: thanks — please add a short postmortem with timeline and action items (kv-cache tuning, batching backoff heuristics, tokenizer readiness).
Priya S: creating follow-up ticket: RWD-ops-4573: investigate hotkey sharding & eviction policies; add safeguards to prevent async batching from producing oversized batches under memory pressure.
Samir K: note: consider adding an early-signal alert for kv-cache-eviction-rate so we don't hit tail SLOs first.
Alex G: checking last check: p99 now 0.82s, p95 390ms, traffic normal. marking as resolving in 10m if stable.
incident-bot: Auto-check: p99=0.82s (1m avg) — stabilization holding.
Maria L: CS: Customers updated: "We implemented temporary routing and performance fixes; we're monitoring. Follow-up email will include root cause once analysis complete."
Alex G: handing off to Oncall Rotation for post-incident follow-up. leaving notes in the incident doc.
Oncall Rotation: acknowledged. will kick off postmortem and assign owners.
pagerduty: INC-20284 acknowledged and resolved by Oncall Rotation (resolution summary available in INC-20284).
Alex G: thx team. quick debrief later. :thumbsup:
